lines.en: label mollycafe25:
scene mollycleaning1
: Guh...
It’s dark by the time I make it to the cafe.
lines.zh: 等我到咖啡馆时，天已经黑了。

lines.en: Molly, still attempting to put the pieces of herself together after losing several of them recently, has spent the last ten minutes wiping down the same spot on the counter without realizing it.
lines.zh: Molly 最近丢了自己的好几块碎片，还在试着把它们拼回去，过去十分钟里她一直在擦柜台上同一个地方，自己却浑然不觉。

lines.en: I think about informing her but, at this point, I’m curious to see whether or not she can manage cleaning it so thoroughly that it burns a hole into the bar.
lines.zh: 我本想提醒她，但事到如今，我倒很好奇她能不能把那块地方擦得彻底到在吧台上擦出一个洞来。

lines.en: I imagine that we are at least another ten minutes away from anything like that happening, unfortunately.
lines.zh: 可惜我估计，要真擦到那种程度，至少还得再等十分钟。

lines.en: : Keep it up, Molly. Just a little while longer until your goal is accomplished.
lines.zh: : 加油，Molly。再坚持一会儿，你的目标就达成了。

lines.en: scene mollycleaning2
: Are you kidding, Sir? We’ve been closed for ten minutes already and there are still guests inside. I am never going home.
lines.zh: : 您开什么玩笑，先生？我们已经打烊十分钟了，里面还有客人在。我永远都回不了家了。

lines.en: : At this rate, my long rest is going to turn into a short rest and I’m not even going to recover all of my hit points.
lines.zh: : 照这个速度，我的长休就要变成短休了，而且我连生命值都回不满。

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how low my health is right now? A leaf could fall on my foot and knock me unconscious.
lines.zh: : 您知道我现在血量有多低吗？一片叶子掉在我脚上都能把我砸晕。

lines.en: : Sounds like a big leaf.
lines.zh: : 听起来是片大叶子。

lines.en: scene mollycleaning3
: Hah. Getting eliminated by nature certainly would be an ironic way to go after spending most of my life indoors.
lines.zh: : 哈。我这辈子大部分时间都待在室内，最后要是被大自然给淘汰了，那可真够讽刺的。

lines.en: : If only I had listened to my father and went outside to play with all of the “normal” kids more often.
lines.zh: : 我要是当初听爸爸的话，多出去跟那些「正常」小孩玩就好了。

lines.en: : I’m a little confused about what a “normal” Molly would even be like.
lines.zh: : 我有点搞不懂，一个「正常」的 Molly 到底会是什么样。

lines.en: scene mollycleaning4
: Probably a little like the abnormal one, but less loud and better at not destroying friendships.
lines.zh: : 大概跟那个不正常的差不多，只是没那么吵，也更擅长不去毁掉友谊。

lines.en: : Yeah. I figured that might have had something to do with your unenthusiastic demeanor tonight.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我就猜你今晚这副无精打采的样子，跟这多少有点关系。

lines.en: : Unenthusiastic demeanor?
lines.zh: : 无精打采的样子？

lines.en: : You’ve been wiping the counter for ten minutes now.
lines.zh: : 你已经擦了十分钟柜台了。

lines.en: : It’s really dirty.
lines.zh: : 那里真的很脏。

lines.en: : In just one spot?
lines.zh: : 只有一个地方脏？

lines.en: : Yes.
: Molly, come on. You’re not fooling anyone.
lines.zh: : Molly，别装了。你骗不了任何人。

lines.en: scene mollycleaning5
: Okay, yeah. So maybe I {i}am{/i} a little less...rambunctious than normal. But my inability to maintain long lasting relationships isn’t a part of that, Sir.
lines.zh: : 好吧，是，就算我{i}确实{/i}比平时……没那么闹腾了一点。但这跟我维持不了长久关系这件事可没关系，先生。

lines.en: : I’ve simply been losing sleep lately.
lines.zh: : 我只是最近有点失眠而已。

lines.en: : Right. And {i}why{/i} are you losing sleep, Molly?
lines.zh: : 好吧。那你{i}为什么{/i}失眠，Molly？

lines.en: scene mollycleaning6
: Why, gaming of course!
lines.zh: : 那还用问，当然是打游戏！

lines.en: : I don’t have time to grieve over my missteps when I have alts to level and fictional characters to put my fictional penis inside of!
lines.zh: : 我还有小号要练级，还有虚构角色等着我用虚构的鸡巴去插呢，哪有时间为我犯下的错伤心！

lines.en: : Yes, I can see now how valuable your time truly is.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我现在总算明白你的时间有多宝贵了。

lines.en: : Are you sure that’s it, though?
lines.zh: : 不过你确定就只是因为这个吗？

lines.en: scene mollycleaning7
: You’re showing an awful lot of concern tonight when you normally seem to completely overlook me, Sir.
lines.zh: : 您今晚对我关心得出奇，平时您好像完全无视我的存在呢，先生。

lines.en: : I never {i}overlook{/i} you. You’re just a little more exhausting to spend time with than most of the other girls.
lines.zh: : 我从来没有{i}无视{/i}你。只是跟你待在一起，比跟其他女孩待在一起更累一点。

lines.en: : That makes sense.
lines.zh: : 说得也是。

lines.en: : Plus, I always manage to be around people when they’re at the worst of their worst, and I’d like to avoid that with you if at all possible.
lines.zh: : 而且我总是在别人最糟糕的时候恰好出现在他们身边，所以如果可能的话，我不想让你也这样。

lines.en: : You already found me at the worst of my worst when I was...admiring Rin’s Instagram.
lines.zh: : 您其实已经见过我最糟糕的样子了，就是我……对着 Rin 的 Instagram 出神的时候。

lines.en: : Was that really the {i}worst{/i}?
lines.zh: : 那真的是{i}最糟糕{/i}的时候吗？

lines.en: : Not at the time, but I imagine the embarrassment will linger in my mind far longer than what I am experiencing now.
lines.zh: : 当时倒不算，但我想那份羞耻会在我脑子里停留得比现在经历的一切都久。

lines.en: : That sounds...surprisingly mature for you.
lines.zh: : 这听起来……出乎意料地成熟啊。

lines.en: scene mollycleaning8
: Then I suppose it would be for the best if I were to compare it to yet another reference to a video game you have never played in hopes that you will somehow understand what I’m talking about.
lines.zh: : 那我想，最好还是再拿一个您从没玩过的游戏来打比方，好让您多少能明白我在说什么。

lines.en: : That’s the Molly I know.
lines.zh: : 这才是我认识的 Molly。

lines.en: : This whole thing with Rin is like a bout of resurrection sickness.
lines.zh: : 我和 Rin 的这件事，就像一场复活后的虚弱。

lines.en: : For a little while, everything is going to hurt a lot more than normal. And I’m going to have to be more careful about the things I do and...who I party up with.
lines.zh: : 在一段时间内，做什么都会比平时更疼。我也得更小心地对待自己做的事，还有……和谁组队。

lines.en: : But that will fade over time.
lines.zh: : 但这一切都会随时间淡去。

lines.en: : I just need to go AFK for a little while. Or put myself on autorun against the corner of a wall or something like that.
lines.zh: : 我只需要暂时挂机一小会儿。或者把自己设成自动寻路、顶着墙角走之类的。

lines.en: : Well, if anything, you have definitely succeeded in getting me lost.
lines.zh: : 好吧，不管怎么说，你确实成功把我给绕晕了。

lines.en: scene mollycleaning9
: You know...the worst part of all of it isn’t that she’s with someone else now. Or that things between us will take a long time to get back to normal.
lines.zh: : 您知道吗……最糟的不是她现在跟别人在一起了，也不是我们之间要花很久才能回到从前。

lines.en: : It’s the embarrassment of what happened. And the moments at work where our eyes meet and we have to quickly look in opposite directions to avoid feeling awkward around one another.
lines.zh: : 最糟的是发生那件事带来的羞耻感。还有上班时我们的目光撞在一起，又得赶紧各自看向别处，免得彼此尴尬。

lines.en: : It’s like a scene out of the end of a visual novel, where two characters who were once close have grown apart and don’t want to stop each other from going their separate ways.
lines.zh: : 就像视觉小说结尾的一幕：两个曾经亲密的角色渐行渐远，却谁也不愿拦着对方走向各自的远方。

lines.en: : Who are you and what have you done with Molly?
lines.zh: : 你是谁，你把 Molly 怎么了？

lines.en: scene mollycleaning10
: Gah! I’m sorry, okay?! The sleep deprivation is making me more mature than I want to be!
lines.zh: : 啊！对不起啦，行了吧？！都是缺觉害的，让我变得比自己想要的成熟多了！

lines.en: scene mollycleaning11
: Besides, just because the hardest part isn’t what I expected doesn’t mean the whole thing isn’t hard at all.
lines.zh: : 再说，最难的那一关不是我想的那样，也不代表整件事就不难了。

lines.en: : It sucks. I hate it times a million and I want these stupid human feelings to leave my body so I can go back to focusing on games and nothing {i}but{/i} games.
lines.zh: : 糟透了。我恨死它了，恨上一百万遍，我只想让这些愚蠢的人类感情从我身体里滚出去，好让我重新专注于游戏，{i}除了{/i}游戏什么也不想。

lines.en: : Maybe preserve a little bit of that focus for work, though.
lines.zh: : 不过那份专注力，也许还是留一点点给工作吧。

lines.en: : Haruka will be mad if you clean a hole into her bar.
lines.zh: : 你要是在她的吧台上擦出一个洞来，Haruka 会生气的。

lines.en: scene mollycleaning3
: {i}Hah.{/i} To tell ya the truth...I haven’t really been a great employee as of late.
lines.zh: : {i}哈{/i}。说实话……我最近算不上是个好员工。

lines.en: : {i}What? You? No...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}什么？你？不会吧……{/i}

lines.en: scene mollycleaning2
: Okay. I haven’t been a great employee as of...ever.
lines.zh: : 好吧。我不是个好员工这件事……从一开始就是。

lines.en: : But I’ve been even worse lately.
lines.zh: : 只是最近变得更糟了。

lines.en: : Honestly, Sir? I think I would have been fired already if Haruka didn’t understand, to some extent, the feelings I am so unfortunately...feeling right now.
lines.zh: : 说实话，先生？如果不是 Haruka 多少能理解我这会儿很不走运地……正在感受的这些情绪，我想我早就被开除了。

lines.en: : Then the least you can do is not destroy her belongings.
lines.zh: : 那你至少能做到不去毁掉她的东西吧。

lines.en: scene mollycleaning4
: Sir, may I ask you a question?
lines.zh: : 先生，我能问您一个问题吗？

lines.en: : Does being disliked and being bad at your job ever keep {i}you{/i} awake at night?
lines.zh: : 被人讨厌、又干不好自己的工作，这种事会让{i}您{/i}夜里睡不着吗？

lines.en: : I thought it was gaming that was keeping you awake at night?
lines.zh: : 我以为让你熬夜的是打游戏？

lines.en: : Well...yes. It is.
lines.zh: : 嗯……是，没错。

lines.en: : Games certainly are the most prominent cause of my current lack of energy, but there {i}are{/i} times that I have to lay in bed where I can’t just...escape it all.
lines.zh: : 游戏的确是我现在精神不济最主要的原因，但{i}有时候{/i}我躺在床上，就是没法……把所有事都抛开。

lines.en: : At least not until the NerveGear is actually developed and I can just full dive into a completely different world and start over from zero.
lines.zh: : 至少在 NerveGear 真正被发明出来之前不行——到那时我就能完全潜入一个截然不同的世界，从零开始重新来过。

lines.en: scene mollycleaning12
: Ooh! If that ever happens, you should come with me!
lines.zh: : 哦！要是真有那么一天，您一定要跟我一起去！

lines.en: : If what happens? I think you forgot that not everyone understands your lingo again.
lines.zh: : 要是哪样？你大概又忘了，不是所有人都听得懂你的行话。

lines.en: : A virtual reality helmet that lets you live a completely new life inside of a virtual realm!
lines.zh: : 就是那种虚拟现实头盔，能让你在一个虚拟的世界里过上全新的人生！

lines.en: : Think of all the amazing things you could do there!
lines.zh: : 想想你在那儿能做多少美妙的事吧！

lines.en: : I could finally have sex with an elf...
lines.zh: : 我终于可以跟精灵做爱了……

lines.en: scene mollycleaning13
: Oooh, an elf lover.
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦，精灵爱好者。

lines.en: : Hey, no one mentioned love. I just want to bang one.
lines.zh: : 嘿，谁提爱了。我只是想睡一个。

lines.en: : Luckily for you, NPCs are incapable of love! And in a fictional setting, they’d probably be easier to woo as well!
lines.zh: : 您运气不错，NPC 是不会恋爱的！而且在虚构的世界里，搞不好也更容易攻略！

lines.en: : Not that you have any issue with wooing women or anything. I mean, you {i}are{/i} the Herald of the Adolescents, after all.
lines.zh: : 倒不是说您攻略女人有什么困难。毕竟您{i}可是{/i}「青春期的先驱者」嘛。

lines.en: : I’m just going to assume that this section of the conversation is over and that I have your full support when it comes to interspecies sexual intercourse.
lines.zh: : 我就当这段对话到此为止，而且在跨物种性交这件事上，我得到了您的全力支持。

lines.en: scene mollycleaning14
: Of course, Sir! In fact, I have a lengthy list of h-games readily available to scratch that exact itch of yours!
lines.zh: : 当然了，先生！事实上，我手上有一长串 H 游戏，随时都能解您这块痒！

lines.en: : Thanks, but I’ll probably stick to real humans for the time being.
lines.zh: : 谢了，不过我大概暂时还是只跟真人打交道吧。

lines.en: scene mollycleaning3
: Gah. How boring.
lines.zh: : 啊。真没劲。

lines.en: : Weren’t you head over heels for an actual human being until just recently?
lines.zh: : 你不久之前还不是为一个活生生的人神魂颠倒吗？

lines.en: scene mollycleaning2
: Well...yes. But then I received a cruel reminder as to why I shouldn’t be getting involved in affairs like that in the first place.
lines.zh: : 嗯……是。可后来我被人残酷地提醒了一顿，明白了为什么我一开始就不该卷进这种感情里。

lines.en: : I’m happy that Rin is happy.
lines.zh: : 我为 Rin 能幸福而高兴。

lines.en: : Well, partially happy.
lines.zh: : 嗯，部分是高兴。

lines.en: : And the other parts?
lines.zh: : 那其他部分呢？

lines.en: scene mollycleaning7
: Well...they’d obviously have to be unhappy, wouldn’t they?
lines.zh: : 嗯……那显然只能是不高兴了，不是吗？

lines.en: : Unhappy {i}why{/i}?
lines.zh: : {i}为什么{/i}不高兴？

lines.en: : Probably...the same reason I’m happy. Just spun around until it can’t stand up anymore and has to throw up all over the floor.
lines.zh: : 大概……跟我高兴的理由是同一个。只是被转啊转，转到再也站不住，只能吐得满地都是。

lines.en: : It’s okay to just...not be happy, you know? I-
lines.zh: : 不高兴也没关系的，你知道吗？我——

lines.en: scene mollycleaning15
: Thank you, Sir. But I’d like to save a conversation as depressing as this for a time when it’s easier for me to escape into more allusions.
lines.zh: : 谢谢您，先生。不过这么沉重的话题，我想留到哪天我能更轻松地躲进更多典故里的时候再聊。

lines.en: : Sure. That’s fine. I just don’t want you feeling down if there is an option to not do that.
lines.zh: : 好，没问题。我只是不想让你明明可以不这么难受，却还是难受着。

lines.en: : That is the issue, though, Sir.
lines.zh: : 可问题就在这里，先生。

lines.en: : I {i}deserve{/i} to feel down right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在是{i}活该{/i}难受。

lines.en: : I did a horrible thing. Not just once, but twice.
lines.zh: : 我做了很过分的事。不是一次，是两次。

lines.en: : If I get hung up on the fact that it did not personally benefit me instead of being happy for a friend or...{i}whatever{/i} she is now, who finally got something she wanted...
lines.zh: : 如果我只纠结于这件事没让我自己得到好处，而不去为一位朋友——或者{i}不管她现在算什么{/i}——终于得到了她想要的东西而高兴……

lines.en: : Well...I think I’d feel even worse about myself than I already do.
lines.zh: : 嗯……那我大概会比现在更瞧不起自己。

lines.en: : So what, then? Are you just going to go back to ignoring those feelings?
lines.zh: : 那你打算怎么办？就这么继续无视这些感觉？

lines.en: : If you get good enough at ignoring something, it eventually feels like it’s not even there.
lines.zh: : 如果你无视某样东西够熟练，到最后就会觉得它根本不存在。

lines.en: : And while it might not sound like a storybook ending, that outcome would be better than anything else I can think of right now.
lines.zh: : 虽然这听起来不像童话里的结局，但就我现在能想到的结果里，这已经是最好的了。

lines.en: : It sounds good to me too.
lines.zh: : 我觉得也挺好。

lines.en: scene mollycleaning16
: Yeah?
lines.zh: : 真的？

lines.en: : Yeah.
: To be honest, I was expecting you to be doing a lot worse than you actually are.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我本来以为你会比现在惨得多。

lines.en: : I know that you’ve been through some pretty rough shit in the past, but I also know that this was important enough for you to break down in my arms about before.
lines.zh: : 我知道你以前经历过不少烂事，但我也知道，这件事重要到让你曾经在我怀里崩溃过。

lines.en: : But if you feel like you’re capable of just ignoring it and letting time do its shitty thing of taking forever to make you feel slightly better, go for it.
lines.zh: : 不过如果你觉得自己能就这么无视它，让时间去做它那套磨磨蹭蹭、让你稍微好受一点的破事，那就随你吧。

lines.en: : Not like I can really help anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正我也帮不上什么忙。

lines.en: : Oh, also, your last customer just left.
lines.zh: : 哦，对了，您最后一位客人刚走。

lines.en: scene mollycleaning17
: A-ha! Then you {i}can{/i} help!
lines.zh: : 啊哈！那您就{i}能{/i}帮忙了！

lines.en: : Please don’t make me clean the store. I don’t work here.
lines.zh: : 拜托别让我打扫店里。我又不在这儿上班。

lines.en: scene mollycleaning18
: So you’ll do anything possible to cheer me up {i}except{/i} for helping me do my job?
lines.zh: : 所以{i}只要不{/i}帮我干活，您什么办法都愿意用来哄我开心？

lines.en: : I don’t think I ever said {i}anything{/i}.
lines.zh: : 我好像{i}什么{/i}都没说过吧。

lines.en: : I believe it was implied, Sir.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那是不言而喻的，先生。

lines.en: : Are you not aware of my incapability to perform at my full potential right now?
lines.zh: : 您难道不知道，我现在根本发挥不出全部实力吗？

lines.en: : There is a darkness growing within me that is sucking out my life essence as we speak. How would you feel in my shoes?!
lines.zh: : 有一团黑暗正在我体内滋长，就在此刻吸食着我的生命精华。您要是处在我的位置会怎么想？！

lines.en: : Eh. Getting life juice sucked out of me doesn’t sound too bad right now.
lines.zh: : 嗯。被人吸走生命汁液，现在听起来也不算太糟。

lines.en: scene mollycleaning19
: W-Well...no! I guess...it would make sense for you to say that!
lines.zh: : 那、那个……不对！我想……您会这么说也情有可原！

lines.en: : But I would still very much appreciate it if you could, at the very least, place the chairs on top of all of the tables.
lines.zh: : 但至少，我还是非常希望您能把椅子全都搬到桌子上面去。

lines.en: scene mollycleaning20
: As a...one time favor to me for...not making your life as difficult as you expected me to tonight.
lines.zh: : 就当是……卖我一次人情，作为……我今晚没把您的生活弄得跟您预想的一样糟糕的报答。

lines.en: : And also if you’d walk me home after we’re done.
lines.zh: : 还有就是，忙完之后送我回家。

lines.en: : So a two time favor.
lines.zh: : 那就是卖两次人情了。

lines.en: : One time consisting of two things.
lines.zh: : 一次，包含两件事。

lines.en: : Maybe a third when we get back to the dorm. Who knows?
lines.zh: : 等回到宿舍说不定还有第三次。谁知道呢？

lines.en: : Can you do {i}me{/i} a favor when we get back to the dorm?
lines.zh: : 等我们回到宿舍，您能帮{i}我{/i}一个忙吗？

lines.en: : Is this favor you have in mind a lewd one?
lines.zh: : 您心里想的这个忙，是色色的那种吗？

lines.en: : Is it {i}allowed{/i} to be a lewd one?
lines.zh: : {i}可以{/i}是色色的那种吗？

lines.en: : Is my name Molly Medb MacCormack?
lines.zh: : 我叫 Molly Medb MacCormack 吗？

lines.en: : ...Maybe?
: Wrong! It is Molly Moyra MacCormack!
lines.zh: : 错！是 Molly Moyra MacCormack！

lines.en: : Why do you not know this?!
lines.zh: : 您怎么会不知道这个？！

lines.en: : It wasn’t in your character profile.
lines.zh: : 你的角色档案里没写。

lines.en: : Silence! Chairs! Go go go!
lines.zh: : 闭嘴！搬椅子！快快快！

lines.en: scene black
I sigh to myself and somehow let Molly bully me into helping out in some way.
lines.zh: 我暗自叹了口气，不知怎么就被 Molly 半哄半逼地拉去帮忙了。

lines.en: I really don’t care as much as I made it seem, though.
lines.zh: 不过我其实没有自己表现出的那么在意。

lines.en: It’s not like this place has {i}that{/i} many chairs...and the ones they do have are relatively light.
lines.zh: 这地方的椅子本来就没{i}多少{/i}……而且有的那些也相对轻。

lines.en: As such, I’m able to finish the task in several minutes and proceed to wait by the counter (That lives to see another day) for Molly to finish her portion of the work.
lines.zh: 所以我几分钟就干完了，然后就在柜台边（它又活过了一天）等着 Molly 把她那部分做完。

lines.en: She does what I imagine is a half-assed job and finishes up in about twenty minutes before changing back into her winter clothes and beckoning me outside.
lines.zh: 她大概敷衍了事地干完，二十分钟左右收工，然后换回自己的冬装，招呼我出去。

lines.en: scene mollycleaning21
: Alas, the stars have retreated back into their caves in the depths of the night sky...preserving their light for the end of days as it steadily approaches.
lines.zh: : 唉，星星已经退回夜空深处的洞穴里……把自己的光留给日渐临近的世界末日。

lines.en: : There are no caves in the sky, Molly.
lines.zh: : 天上没有洞穴，Molly。

lines.en: : Of course I know that, Sir.
lines.zh: : 我当然知道，先生。

lines.en: : I just mean that there’s a clear amount of light pollution here. It’s not like it was at the beach.
lines.zh: : 我只是说这里的光污染相当严重。跟在海边的时候不一样。

lines.en: scene mollycleaning22
: Ah. I guess not.
lines.zh: : 啊。我想也是。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t really expect any less in a city, though.
lines.zh: : 不过在城里，本来也没什么可指望的。

lines.en: : You don’t have to expect something before being disappointed, Sir. Sometimes, you can just...be disappointed.
lines.zh: : 您不一定非要先抱有期待才会失望，先生。有时候，您可以就那么……失望。

lines.en: : I like the stars. I wish the sky always looked the way it did when we were there.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢星星。我真希望天空永远都是我们在那儿时的模样。

lines.en: : Don’t let Maya hear that. She’ll probably quiz you on them.
lines.zh: : 别让 Maya 听见。她大概会拿星星考你。

lines.en: : I’d fail a quiz miserably. I just like looking at them.
lines.zh: : 我肯定考得一塌糊涂。我只是喜欢看星星而已。

lines.en: : They’re okay, I guess.
lines.zh: : 它们还行吧，我想。

lines.en: : So, do you intend to venture forth on a side quest back to the dorm with me? Or is this where our party disbands and heads its separate ways?
lines.zh: : 那么，您打算跟我一起踏上回宿舍的支线任务吗？还是说我们的队伍就要在这里解散、各奔东西了？

lines.en: : My answer to this question hinges on how long you plan on talking about stars for.
lines.zh: : 这个答案取决于你还打算聊多久的星星。

lines.en: : I was already done, Sir. I was simply pointing out how I wish there were more.
lines.zh: : 我已经说完了，先生。我只是在感叹，真希望星星能再多一些。

lines.en: : Then yeah. I can come back to the dorm with you.
lines.zh: : 那好。我可以陪你回宿舍。

lines.en: : Excellent. I’ll see to it that you obtain a rather desirable quest reward as a result.
lines.zh: : 太好了。我保证让您拿到一份相当可观的支线奖励。

lines.en: : Lewd or not lewd?
lines.zh: : 是色色的还是不色色的？

lines.en: : Not lewd, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然不色色。

lines.en: : That doesn’t sound very desirable to me.
lines.zh: : 那听起来就不怎么吸引人了。

lines.en: scene mollycleaning23
: Sir, I realize this may be annoying, but would we be able to stop somewhere along the way?
lines.zh: : 先生，我知道这可能很烦人，但我们能不能在路上顺便停一下？

lines.en: : Where did you have in mind?
lines.zh: : 你想去哪儿？

lines.en: : A nearby leyline I like to draw power from when my stocks begin to run low.
lines.zh: : 附近的一条地脉，每当我的储备见底时，我都会去那里汲取力量。

lines.en: : Based on what I know about Mollyspeak...I’m going to assume that means a convenience store.
lines.zh: : 根据我对 Molly 语的了解……我猜你说的是便利店。

lines.en: scene mollycleaning24
: It appears you still have much to learn then, as that answer is rather far from the truth.
lines.zh: : 看来您要学的还多着呢，因为这个答案离真相差得有点远。

lines.en: : Come. Let us pick up yet another side quest and see if that one yields any worthy rewards as well!
lines.zh: : 来吧。让我们再接一个支线任务，看看这回能不能也拿到什么像样的奖励！

lines.en: scene black
$ molly_love += 1
$ mollycafe25 = True
{i}Molly’s affection has increased to [molly_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Molly 的好感度提升到了 [molly_love]!{/i}

lines.en: jump mollycafe25p2
